Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon Collection.name: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon Collection
Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon Collection.summary: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon Collection is a video game released in 1994 for the PC-Engine CD. It is a minigame collection that takes place during the R season.

Rayxanber II.summary: Rayxanber II is an Action game, developed and published by Data West, which was released in Japan in 1991.
